verses.translation: By the fig and the olive

verses.arabicText: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Laqad khalaqnā l-insāna fī aḥsani taqwīm
verses.translation: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti falahum ajrun ghayru mamnūn
verses.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
Is not Allah the most just of judges?
